title: Breakthrough! The AI startup West Lake Xinchen Completes a Several Billion Yuan B+ Round of Financing, with Major Players Investing to Accelerate AI Globalization

content_html:
The large model track has once again seen a strong voice from capital. The well-known domestic large model company, West Lake Xinchen, officially announced in August that the company has successfully completed its Series B+ financing, with a funding amount of hundreds of millions of RMB.

The investment round is strong, attracting deep participation from multiple capitals. Among them, Guangfa Xinde served as the lead investor, with West Lake Innovation Investment, Wuhan Jiangtun Fund, Rongyi Investment, Nantong Investment Management, and other well-known investment institutions participating; at the same time, industrial capital such as Liepin Strategic Investment and 58 Industrial Fund also joined. In addition, the company's existing shareholders, Ant Group and Tomcat, continued to provide comprehensive and firm support.

According to the information, the funds injected in this round will be mainly used for three core directions: first, the continuous R&D and technological breakthroughs of the next-generation diffusion language model; second, accelerating the deep iteration of the company's native multimodal real-time interactive products; finally, further expanding the overseas market and enhancing the brand's competitiveness and influence in the global AI field.

content_html_zh:
大模特赛道再次看到来自资本的强势声音。 国内知名大型模型公司西湖新晨8月正式宣布，公司已成功完成B+轮融资，融资金额达数亿元人民币。

本轮投资力度强劲，吸引多方资本深度参与。 其中，广发信德担任领投方，西湖创新投资、武汉江屯基金、融益投资、南通投管等知名投资机构跟投；与此同时，猎聘战略投资、58产业基金等产业资本也加入其中。 此外，公司现有股东蚂蚁集团和Tomcat继续提供全面、坚定的支持。

据了解，本轮注入的资金将主要用于三个核心方向：一是下一代扩散语言模型的持续研发和技术突破；二是加速公司原生多模态实时交互产品的深度迭代；最后，进一步拓展海外市场，提升品牌在全球人工智能领域的竞争力和影响力。
